description: This file defines the PerformanceTracker entity class for the OrangeHRM project, which models a performance tracking record linked to employees, including properties like tracker name, dates, status, and reviewer relations. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying its fields.

classes.name: PerformanceTracker
classes.description: Entity representing a performance tracking record in the OrangeHRM system, including properties like name, dates, status, relations to employees and reviewers, with ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getTrackerName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setTrackerName
methods.description: Sets the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the tracker was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the tracker was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modification date of the tracker.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the last modification date of the tracker.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the tracker, indicating if it is deleted or not.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the tracker.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this tracker.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this tracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Returns the collection of reviewer entities related to this tracker.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Sets the reviewers for this tracker.

methods.name: getAddedBy
methods.description: Returns the employee who added this tracker.

methods.name: setAddedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee who added this tracker.
